candidates.change_summary: Change the assignment to `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the stored value is the current timestamp rather than timestamp+1.
Change the assignment to `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 2;` so the stored value differs by one extra second.
Delete the statement `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;` so pastBlockTime is never updated.
Delete the statement that updates pastBlockTime, so the public getter pastBlockTime() no longer changes after a call.
Change the assignment to pastBlockTime from block.timestamp + 1 to block.timestamp, altering the value observable via pastBlockTime().
Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) guard so calls with smaller timestamps succeed and update pastBlockTime, changing the observable value.
Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) guard so calls with any value succeed and update pastBlockTime, changing the observable value.
Assign block.number instead of block.timestamp + 1 to pastBlockTime, changing the value observable via pastBlockTime().
Move the pastBlockTime assignment before the timestamp require so reverted-by-guard states still get pastBlockTime updated on failure paths, changing the observable value.
Delete the statement `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;` so subsequent calls are no longer blocked within the same second.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;` with `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so a call in the next block with the same timestamp (or the very next second instead of two) is allowed.
Delete the statement `require(msg.value == 10 ether);` so calls with any value are accepted.
Delete the statement `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);` so repeated calls in the same time period are allowed.
Replace the payout condition `block.number % 15 == 0` with `block.number % 15 != 0`, inverting which blocks pay out.
Replace the transfer of the full balance with a fixed `transfer(1 ether)`, changing the amount sent to the caller.
Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) check so multiple calls in the same block/timestamp are allowed.
Replace the update of pastBlockTime to store block.timestamp instead of block.timestamp + 1.
Delete the assignment pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1 so pastBlockTime is never updated.
Change the payout condition to block.number % 15 != 0 so the transfer happens on different blocks.
Remove the check that msg.value equals 10 ether.
Remove the check that block.timestamp is greater than pastBlockTime.
Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp instead of block.timestamp + 1.
Invert the payout condition to block.number % 15 != 0.
Remove the statement that transfers the contract balance back to the caller.
Delete the statement `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;` so pastBlockTime is never updated.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;` with `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the stored value is one less than in P.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;` with `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 2;` so the stored value is one more than in P.
Move the assignment `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;` to after the if block so it is skipped when the transfer reverts the call.
